paths-desk-light.text:
2 ways to study Electronics#

SDU offers this as 2 paths. What it takes to get in differs between them, so check each one.

PATH	LENGTH	QUOTA 1 NEEDS	DP COURSE RESULTS	WHAT IS DIFFERENT
BSc in Engineering YOU ARE HERE	3 yrs · 180 ECTS	at least 31 IB points
an average of 7.0
	Full Diploma needed	3 years, research-based, and leads straight into the MSc in Engineering. No internship.
Bachelor of Engineering (BEng)	3½ yrs · 210 ECTS	at least 26 IB points
an average of 5.0
	Accepted	3½ years with a six-month internship, aimed at industry; a master’s stays open.
